out.title: L&T secures LNTP for 1,600 MW Chandrapura thermal power plant
out.summary: L&T Energy CarbonLite Solutions received an LNTP from DVC CIL Power Private Ltd for the main plant package of the 2x800 MW Chandrapura ultra-supercritical thermal power plant in Jharkhand; classified a Major order (₹5,000–10,000 crore).
